profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer (iOS/Android) with Read AI

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on the Read AI mobile & bot team!

positions.title: Software Development Engineer I
positions.description: Engineer for Last Mile Maps Client team, responsible for the maps and navigation experience for Amazon Delivery Drivers worldwide. Primarily focused on mobile, but regularly involved with high volume metrics and operational excellence!

positions.title: Computer System Specialist
positions.description:
Assess and trim errors in Astronomy-related software. 
Analyze issues within systems to maximize uptime.
Develop and establish a department website (astronomy.as.virginia.edu).
Correspond with System Administrator to inspect department systems and implement potential fixes.
Research various operating systems and fixes that would best expedite faculty research.

company.name: University of Virginia Department of Astronomy

positions.title: Fashion Director
positions.description:
Lead team of stylists to create curated looks for the latest issue of the magazine.
Head shoots to ensure that all models and crew members are comfortable and capable of working their best.
Design a vision for a photo shoot based on original themes.

positions.title: Software Development Engineering Intern
positions.description: Amazon.com's Logistics technology group is responsible for developing and implementing cutting edge initiatives in delivering packages to our customers as fast as possible while lowering costs for the company. As an SDE on this team, my main focus is innovation in the customer and delivery experience, and building the next generation services which will serve the needs for fast growing selection of items on Amazon.com and new business ventures. This is the same team that delivered last mile innovations such as Amazon Now, Prime Now and Amazon Flex. I work on hard problems at scale and have autonomy to deliver. I learned about real-time adaptive transportation solutions, routing algorithms and optimizations, operating on large-scale datasets,and functional system architecture, using various AWS technologies.

positions.title: IT Security Analyst Intern
positions.description:
Built network monitoring dashboards and reports using Splunk Enterprise. 
Implemented Splunk Machine Learning to create anomaly detection and predictive defense tools. 
Utilized Vulnerability Scanning Software (Rapid7 Nexpose) in order to accelerate inter-departmental projects. 
Collaborated with a team of interns in a project regarding flow of Restricted Access Data (SSN, Payroll Records, etc.) through the record life-cycle.
Presented findings & recommendations regarding data flow through the company to Senior Management.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Create analytical models of which target audiences to project our next advertisements to as well as what practices would be most effective. 
Collect voter information throughout the various precincts.
Question potential voters on their political interests and address their concerns to leadership.
Target unsure voters and emphasize the importance of voting, whilst educating them on Congressman Dold’s platform.
